steps.path: Marketplace → the row under the featured banner
steps.headline: The filter bar is one row: the type switch, a Vibe dropdown, a Show dropdown, and search.
steps.changed: Seven vibe chips became a 'Any vibe' dropdown (pick one). New / Popular / Featured picks became a 'Show' dropdown: Everything, Featured picks, Newest first, Most installed.
steps.notice: Nothing wraps any more. Vibe is now pick-one (it was pick-many) — two vibes at once is gone. Search shrinks first if the window gets narrow.
steps.risk: Below roughly 1100px wide the search box gets short; the bar never wraps but it can feel tight.

steps.headline: MCP servers are called Connections, per your pick.
steps.changed: The segment reads Connections 5; the byline on those cards reads 'Connection · Notion'; 'Adds 1 connection' in What this can do.
steps.notice: The detail page's fine print still says MCP server, so someone who knows the term can confirm what it is.
steps.risk: You flagged it: real non-MCP tools may arrive later and want a different word. The internal name stays 'tool' so renaming is a one-line copy change.

steps.headline: The check badge is a grey shield with a tick reading 'Likely safe', and it comes first.
steps.changed: Checked → grey shield-tick 'Likely safe'. Caution → amber shield-! 'Caution 2'. Not checked → empty grey shield 'Not checked'. Then the origin badge (YouCoded / Verified / Community).
steps.notice: Hover either badge for a one-sentence explanation ('Likely' because no check is perfect…). On phones the shield shows without its word so the row stays on one line.
steps.risk: Hover doesn't exist on touch — the same sentence needs a tap target there; not built this round.

steps.headline: Cards have a fixed shape: title, byline, badges, two-line blurb, then abilities in words, then feedback and contents.
steps.changed: The globe/key glyphs are gone. In their place a line of words — 'Uses the internet · Needs a key' — on its own row, only when there is something to say. The blurb always reserves two lines so cards in a row line up.
steps.notice: Bottom row now reads feedback on the left (👍 93% · 412 installs) and contents on the right (1 skill · 1 command), each side truncating on its own instead of fighting for one line.
steps.risk: Cards are about one line taller than round 1; rails scroll a little more.

steps.headline: The same cleaned-up card in the split view, where most cards have no numbers yet.
steps.changed: Badge order and the reserved blurb height apply here too, so a card with 'Part of Superpowers' and one without sit at the same height.
steps.notice: Skills with no votes show no percent rather than 0%; the contents line is empty for a single skill, so those cards end with the badge row.
steps.risk: Whether the empty bottom on single-skill cards reads as tidy or unfinished is your call.

steps.headline: The phone Filters sheet: the type row scrolls inside the sheet's edges, and the chips are the same two dropdowns.
steps.changed: Round 1 let the type row bleed past the sheet's padding, which looked like overflow. It now scrolls within the padding. Vibe and Show are full-width dropdowns.
steps.notice: The fourth segment is cut at the padding edge — that's the cue that the row scrolls.
steps.risk: Still no fade at the edge; the cut segment is the only hint.

steps.headline: The detail page's trust line uses the same shield-first order and 'Likely safe' wording.
steps.changed: Only the badge order and wording changed here; What this can do and Feedback are as you approved them.
steps.notice: Same two badges as the card, slightly larger, then 'from anthropics/…' and 'Part of …' when they apply.
